rationale: First canonical baseline EXP plan for H-012 under bounded Path B Option B. This plan tests a 15m trend-following signal with a funding-rate context filter. Main 4.0 accepted ohlcv_15m as convention application against locked surfaces, not taxonomy expansion. No execution occurs in this package; WP-S2c-128 performs any backtest only if later authorized. The main design risk is 15m cost drag. WP-S2c-127b refined v_integrity_plan_report_pairs so this valid pre-execution EXP-without-REP state is healthy only while H-012 remains DRAFT / PENDING / pre_registered with no trial IDs and no decision record.
hypothesis_to_test: A BTCUSDT 15m trend-following baseline using ohlcv_15m, gated or attenuated by funding_8h context, will produce positive OOS Sharpe more often than random entry over walk-forward folds, reduce false-signal rate versus an ungated 15m trend baseline, and satisfy D2-006 gates only if net-of-cost performance, drawdown, sensitivity, cost-drag, concentration, free-parameter, and walk-forward-efficiency constraints all pass.

gates: D2-006 Gate 1: Out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs
D2-006 Gate 2: DSR > 1.0 at 95% confidence given actual trial count
D2-006 Gate 3: Max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold
D2-006 Gate 4: Parameter sensitivity with +/-25% parameter shift keeps Sharpe within 70% of baseline
D2-006 Gate 5: Cost drag <= 50% of gross PnL
D2-006 Gate 6: No single 90-day window contributes > 60% of total PnL
D2-006 Gate 8: Walk-forward efficiency (OOS/IS Sharpe ratio) > 0.5
Passing D2-006 gates does not itself authorize readiness or transition
additional_criteria: EXP-0012 is authored and validated before any H-012 backtest begins.
No backtest, trial-log, REP, OL/REC, or DEC is created in WP-S2c-127.
WP-S2c-128, if authorized, uses only pre-registered H-012 streams and parameters.
All WP-S2c-128 backtest runs must be logged in research/trial_log.jsonl before REP creation.
Baseline uses at most three free parameters.
Cost drag must be measured explicitly.
Funding context filter must be evaluated against pure 15m trend comparator without creating a second registered candidate.
No readiness, transition, recommendation, ranking, or scoring authority is created.
The pre-execution EXP-without-REP state is bounded by WP-S2c-127b and ends once trial evidence or decision state exists.

data_requirements: No external, paid, Tier 4, protected-path, runtime, paper/live, broker/exchange/order/live API contact.
No separate IS/OOS split convention is introduced by this package; evaluation windows remain null until WP-S2c-128 execution/reporting if repo convention requires concrete splits.
Main 4.0 accepted ohlcv_15m as convention application against locked surfaces, not taxonomy expansion.
